snippet.title: Pax Autocratica - Official Early Access Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Pax Autocratica will come to early access on 10 August 2026.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1067360/Pax_Autocratica/

Build a grand totalitarian colony then personally storm roguelite battlefields with your soldiers. Shape citizens fears, loyalties, bonds, and feuds. Capture enemies, convert them into true believers. Sacrifice the weak. Feed the strong. Wield absolute power and make every life bend to your will. 

Developer: Multiverse
X: https://x.com/PaxAutocratica
